changes: Synchronous stopping gate on all tests and resource acquisition prevents post-cleanup launches.
Track listeners, pending acquisitions, accepted probe/fixture sockets and HTTP clients; independent eight-second cleanup deadline.
Await child close/stdio drain; preserve evidence and audit expected exits, including log-finalization failure.
Strict final JSONL completeness and exact per-request method/path record-count audit.
Explicitly retain unexercised slow-stream/backpressure stress and lifecycle meta-tests; no false claim from unexecuted cases.
